observations: Seller provided only text reply; no new photos or videos were shared.
Existing photos still do not show readable brand/model, tire size, load/speed rating, or DOT date code.
Existing photos still do not show clear tread-depth measurement or wear bars, and do not show inner liner/repair areas.

claims.claim: No o, I tested it myself yesterday, everything I said is true.
claims.evidence: No new photo/video or test result was provided to verify the claim.
No readable brand/origin markings on the tire sidewalls in photos 0-2.
Photos 0-2 do not provide a clear tread-depth measurement, wear bars, or close-up of the tread surface.
No close-up of the inner liner/sidewall area where patches would be visible.
No close-up/side profile showing the full circumference for bulges.
No DOT date code or proof of vehicle year in photos 0-2.

risks.risk: Tire size/fitment mismatch (wrong size or mixed sizes) affecting usability and value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the full sidewall text for each tire showing size (e.g., 205/55R16), load/speed rating, and brand/model.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as mixed/unknown fitment used tires (worst-case for buyer).

risks.risk: Tread depth may be far less than claimed (90%) or uneven wear.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of tread with a ruler/coin for scale and a photo showing tread wear indicators (bars) if present.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worn used tires (not 90% tread).

risks.risk: Repairs/patching or internal damage not visible from current angles.
risks.proof: Photos of the inner liner and any repair areas (and/or a video flex/inspection showing no internal bubbles).

risks.risk: Sidewall bulges, cracks, or impact damage not visible in the current angles.
risks.proof: Full sidewall circumference close-ups for each tire (front/back/left/right) in good light.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as tires with unknown structural condition.

risks.risk: Age may be older than 2023 despite the seller’s claim.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the DOT code on each tire (week/year).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as older used tires (worst-case age).

proof_requests: Clear sidewall close-ups for each tire showing: brand/model (if any), size, load/speed rating, and DOT code.
A tread-depth proof: close-up of tread with a ruler/coin and photo of wear bars (if present).
Inner liner/repair inspection photos (to confirm no patch).
Full sidewall circumference photos to confirm no bulge/cracks.
response.reason: The seller’s text claim of testing doesn’t replace missing visual proof. Without readable size/DOT and clear tread/damage evidence, a worst-case price can’t be set reliably from remote inspection.
